notes: Vishvora 0.27.0 - Sounds while you read: rain, a hearth, wind, the sea, a night forest (Reader, More, Sounds). "Follow the story" changes them with the page. - Home-screen widget "Continue reading", and shortcuts on the app icon (Continue, Add a book, New note). - Time left in the chapter and the book, at your own reading speed. - Ask the book: what happened so far, who someone is, what a passage means, from the pages you have read only. Needs a free Gemini key (paste it once).
